source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
Entactogen antidotes are defined as any chemical compound directly associated with the reduction of entactogen subjective effects.

This page lists commonly available entactogen antidotes.
